## B — Driving, right of way and sharing rules
Audience: first-time Montana non-commercial Class D applicants studying driving, right of way and sharing rules.
Level: introductory rule retrieval; the ordered handbook section is the coverage basis, without any invented official examination weight. Prerequisites and confusable topics: The previous sections on signs, signals and markings; the distinction between yielding the right-of-way and holding it, and between passing on the left and the narrow cases for passing on the right.
This is a research handoff. Read physical pages forty-seven through fifty-three as ordinary driving-rule guidance. Speed-table values are carried only as stated in the extracted table. School, procession and cyclist duties that depend on local conditions remain debt until the displayed control is confirmed.
